status_note: 规则结构与以 T 表示的阈值沿用我 2026 年 9 月实盘 Meta/TikTok 线索投放所用的打法；账户、广告组、素材、价格以及单位经济参数（线索价值、通过率、目标 ROAS）均为虚构。
status_note_en: Accounts, ad sets, creatives, prices and the unit economics (value per lead, approval rate, target ROAS) are fictional; the rule structure and the thresholds expressed relative to T follow the playbook I used on live Meta/TikTok lead-gen accounts in September 2026. The reconciliation tolerances are reference values for this offline replay.
economics_note: T = 每条线索价值（offer.unit_price）× 线索通过率（quality_factor）÷ 目标 ROAS。quality_factor 是结算方认可的线索占比；目标 ROAS 1.25 表示每花 1 元要收回 1.25 元结算收入。因此 T 必须低于每条线索的价值：本参考口径下 10.00 → T = 7.20，8.00 → T = 5.76。
economics_note_en: T = value per lead (offer.unit_price) × lead approval rate (quality_factor) ÷ target ROAS. quality_factor is the share of leads the settlement approves; a target ROAS of 1.25 means every 1.00 spent must return 1.25 in settled revenue. T therefore stays below the value of a lead: 10.00 → T = 7.20, 8.00 → T = 5.76, 12.00 → T = 8.64.
budget_examples_note: HYPOTHETICAL。T 只是可接受 CPA 的锚，实际预算档位由团队自行决定。

recommended_creatives_per_adset.note: Guidance for CREATIVE_OVERFLOW's trim target; the engine only enforces max_creatives_per_adset.

sample_gate._why: 零转化有两种性质完全不同的原因：素材真的不行，或者样本根本不够。先过样本关再谈判定。
sample_gate.judgement_rule: 判死需要「展示 >= 300 且 0 转化」同时「累计花费 >= 止损线」；中间只记录，不改状态。

promotion._why: 晋级的三个条件必须同时成立，缺一个就只记录。
promotion.rule: 转化数够 + 覆盖完整投放日 + 该档独立算 CPA <= T。
promotion.budget_rule: 每次晋级把预算升到下一档：ladder 中各档是基础预算的 1、2、3 倍，所以 T -> 2T 为 x2，2T -> 3T 为 x1.5。
promotion.budget_rule_en: Each promotion moves the budget to the next ladder step. The ladder stages are 1, 2 and 3 times the base budget, so T → 2T is ×2 and 2T → 3T is ×1.5.

stop_loss._why: 这是超过目标成本的测试止损线，不等于财务净亏损，也不证明素材永远无效。暂停可恢复。
rules: 零转化：累计消耗达 3T 仍无转化，且正常回传时间已过 -> 暂停复核。
有转化但持续过贵：累计花费 - T x 转化数 >= 3T -> 暂停复核。

utilisation._why: 「花不动」和「不够花」是两种病，混在一句话里就会开错药。

at_cap_above.note: Read by people, not by the engine: above 107% counts as fully spent, within the platform's allowed overdelivery.

utilisation.note: 预算利用率 <= 50% 判花不动，先解决出价/预算能不能花的问题；107% 以上视为顶满，是平台允许的超投区间。

creative_rules.circuit_breaker_note: 单条素材吃掉组内 40% 以上花费、且 CPA 高于目标 1.7 倍 -> 熔断该素材，不动整组。
creative_rules.fatigue_note: 判衰竭必须三条同时满足：频次 >= 2.5 且 CTR 环比降 >= 20% 且 CVR 同向降 >= 20%。只满足一条属于误判。

reconciliation._why: Platform numbers drive the decisions, but the settlement decides what is paid. On 2026-09-20 the daily sheet, pulled from every connected account, ran about 20% above the settlement export until it was scoped to the accounts the settlement covers (about 0.1% on the checked day). Compare like with like before acting on cost.
reconciliation.results_rule: Settled leads are compared with platform leads × quality_factor, because the settlement only pays approved leads.
reconciliation.note: Tolerances are reference values for this offline replay, not thresholds from the live accounts. RECON_SCOPE is reported but does not downgrade by default: an account outside the settlement has nothing to reconcile against. Add it to downgrade_on to require a settlement row before any cost-based write.

learning.note: 门槛日预算 = 7.14 x 可代价位。若按单次转化目标计。学习期内不做 significant edit。

gate_states._note: Descriptive text only. The five states are implemented in code (operating_rules.gate) and are not configurable here.
gate_states.ready: 现值与基线一致 -> 只发差异字段，其余行独立执行。
gate_states.satisfied: 现值已是目标值 -> 跳过不写（写了是 significant edit，会重置学习期）。
gate_states.conflict: 当前值与基线、目标均不一致 -> 隔离该行，暂缓修改并核对变更来源，不覆盖，也不让整批重做。
gate_states.unknown: 没读到写前状态、字段不在快照里，或待修改字段的基线缺失/为 null -> 按具体缺项补充当前状态或原方案基线证据；必要时重新生成并审阅计划，绝不直接放行。

rules: 一律按 campaign / adset 出数，不拿账户总 CPA 直接判素材。
期望转化 < 判死门槛时标「样本不足」，不用它下结论。
成本口径统一叫 CPA；区分平台口径与结算口径。
不确定的字段如实标 unknown，不用推断填空。

actions.action: 原组预算升到下一档（T -> 2T -> 3T，即基础预算的 1 / 2 / 3 倍）
actions.acceptance: 回读 daily_budget = 目标档位金额，且变更流水可查（某一天必须用 since=D, until=D+1 拉取）。两者不一致视为未执行。
actions.stop_condition: 回读发现 bid_strategy / bid_amount 被默认覆盖，或该档未覆盖完整投放日 -> 本轮不晋级，先修结构。

en.trigger: At least {promotion.min_results} leads over a full delivery day and the step's own CPA ≤ T
en.action: Raise the original ad set's budget to the next ladder step (T → 2T → 3T: 1, 2 and 3 times the base budget)
en.acceptance: Readback shows daily_budget at the target step and the change appears in the activity log (pull one day as since=D, until=D+1). If either is missing, treat it as not executed.
en.stop_condition: Readback shows bid_strategy / bid_amount reset to a default, or the step has not covered a full delivery day → do not promote this round; fix the structure first.

actions.action: 本轮不晋级、预算不变；先处理同组的素材熔断 / 素材超上界 / 命名与出价不符，或账户级 P0 问题（每个广告组每轮只做一项变更）
actions.acceptance: 阻断项已处理并回读确认；下一轮按晋级条件重新判定，不沿用本轮结论。
actions.stop_condition: 阻断项未处理前不得加预算；不得在同一轮里既改素材又加预算。

en.trigger: Promotion numbers are met, but the ad set has a creative breaker, more than {max_creatives_per_adset} creatives or a MAX name on a capped bid, or the account has a P0 finding
en.action: No promotion this round; budget unchanged. First fix the ad set's creative breaker, creative overflow or name/bid mismatch, or the account's P0 issue (one change per ad set per round)
en.acceptance: The blocker is resolved and confirmed by readback; the next round re-evaluates promotion from scratch instead of reusing this round's result.
en.stop_condition: No budget increase while a blocker is open; never change creatives and budget in the same round.

actions.action: 暂停复核（先查链路与回传，再决定是否放弃）
actions.acceptance: status=PAUSED 回读确认，且链路与回传已核对。
actions.stop_condition: 展示 < 判死门槛时不得按「素材无效」下结论；样本不够只标「未测充分」。

en.trigger: Zero leads, at least {sample_gate.impressions_for_dead} impressions and spend ≥ {stop_loss.measured_in_t}T
en.action: Pause and review (check the destination and conversion tracking before giving up)
en.acceptance: status=PAUSED confirmed by readback, and the destination and tracking have been checked.
en.stop_condition: Below the impression floor, never conclude the creative failed; an insufficient sample is only marked under-tested.

actions.action: 暂停复核；回传未齐可先停新增花费
actions.acceptance: status=PAUSED 回读确认；暂停只停新增花费。
actions.stop_condition: 回传未成熟时不得作确定性排名或停投结论，只保留可靠的花费/展示字段。

en.action: Pause and review; if conversions are still arriving, stop new spend first
en.acceptance: status=PAUSED confirmed by readback; the pause only stops new spend.
en.stop_condition: While conversion reporting is still maturing, make no definitive ranking or stop verdict; keep only the reliable spend and impression fields.

actions.action: 暂停该组（停新增花费）并复核钩子；不下「素材无效」结论
actions.acceptance: status=PAUSED 回读确认，且已定位 CPC 偏高或 CTR 偏低的原因（通常是钩子）。
actions.stop_condition: 展示未达判死门槛时不得下「素材无效」结论；CPC 高通常上游是 CTR 低，要修的是钩子而不是出价。

en.trigger: Zero leads, not yet at the stop rules, with CPC > {sample_gate.early_stop_cpc_above} or CTR < {sample_gate.early_stop_ctr_below|pct}
en.action: Pause the ad set (stop new spend) and review the hook; no verdict that the creative failed
en.acceptance: status=PAUSED confirmed by readback, and the cause of the high CPC or low CTR has been located (usually the hook).
en.stop_condition: Below the impression floor, never conclude the creative failed; a high CPC usually comes from a low CTR upstream, so fix the hook, not the bid.

actions.action: 标记「未测充分」，不判失败；先解决出价/预算能不能花的问题
actions.acceptance: 已把「花不动」定位到具体一项：出价进不了场 / 预算撞顶 / 受众过窄 / 素材被拒。
actions.stop_condition: 未定位就加预算 -> 停手。期望转化不足时一律标「样本不足」，不得据此判素材好坏。

en.trigger: Zero leads below {sample_gate.impressions_for_dead} impressions; or fewer than {promotion.min_results} leads; or budget utilization ≤ {utilisation.under_delivering_below|pct}; or CPA above T but below the stop line
en.action: Mark as under-tested, not failed; first solve whether the budget can be spent
en.acceptance: The spend problem is traced to one cause: the bid cannot enter auctions / the budget is capped / the audience is too narrow / the creative is disapproved.
en.stop_condition: Adding budget before the cause is found → stop. When expected leads are too few, mark the sample as too small and never judge the creative from it.

actions.action: 立即暂停检查，不必等满观察期
actions.acceptance: 目的地实际打开与 offer 相符，且回传参数完整收到 ——「URL 可访问但参数丢失」不算通过。
actions.stop_condition: 参数被吞 / 宏原样落地 / 深链回退错误 -> 暂停该行，不得边跑边修。

en.trigger: The declared destination check (linked) or tracking check (tracking_ok) failed
en.action: Pause and inspect now; no need to wait for the observation window
en.acceptance: The destination actually opens and matches the offer, and conversion parameters arrive complete. "URL loads but parameters are lost" does not pass.
en.stop_condition: Parameters stripped / macros landing unexpanded / wrong deep-link fallback → pause the row; never fix it while it keeps spending.

actions.action: 读取拒审原因；修正素材、文案或落地页中的实质问题后提交审核，或通过平台官方复核渠道（Request Review）申诉；不得重新上传未修改或仅重新编码的素材。
actions.acceptance: 拒审原因已记录；修改或申诉已提交；复读后 effective_status 与审核结果已更新。
actions.stop_condition: 同一原因第二次被拒 → 停止，交人工做政策复核。

en.action: Read the disapproval reason; fix the substance in the creative, copy or landing page and resubmit, or appeal through the platform's official review channel (Request Review). Never re-upload unchanged or merely re-encoded media.
en.acceptance: The disapproval reason is recorded; the edit or appeal is submitted; a re-read shows effective_status and the review result updated.
en.stop_condition: A second rejection for the same reason → stop and hand over to a human policy review.

actions.action: 熔断该条素材，不动整组
actions.acceptance: 该素材已不在组内投放，组内其余素材花费占比重新分布。
actions.stop_condition: 只满足「花费占比高」或只满足「CPA 高」时不得熔断，两条必须同时成立。

en.trigger: At least 2 creatives; one takes more than {creative_rules.circuit_breaker_spend_share_above|pct} of ad-set spend at CPA above {creative_rules.circuit_breaker_cpa_multiple_above} × T
en.action: Switch off that one creative; leave the ad set running
en.acceptance: The creative no longer delivers in the ad set, and spend redistributes across the remaining creatives.
en.stop_condition: Never trip the breaker on a high spend share alone or a high CPA alone; both must hold.

actions.action: 换素材（新增而非替换）；判新素材只看 CVR
actions.acceptance: 新素材已在组内产出转化，且 CVR >= 该链接基线 +20%。
actions.stop_condition: 频次、CTR 降幅、CVR 降幅三条未同时满足时不得判衰竭。

en.trigger: Frequency ≥ {creative_rules.fatigue_frequency_at_least}, with CTR and CVR both down at least {creative_rules.fatigue_drop_at_least|pct} against the prior window
en.action: Add a new creative (add, do not replace); judge the new creative on CVR only
en.acceptance: The new creative has produced leads in the ad set, with CVR ≥ the link's baseline +20%.
en.stop_condition: Do not call fatigue unless frequency, CTR decline and CVR decline all meet their thresholds together.

actions.action: 先裁剪到推荐条数，再谈扩量
actions.acceptance: 组内素材条数已回到推荐上限以内。
actions.stop_condition: 条数超上界时不得直接扩量 —— 预算放大只会让系统更集中在少数几条上。

en.trigger: More than {max_creatives_per_adset} creatives in the ad set
en.action: Trim to the recommended number of creatives before scaling
en.acceptance: The ad set is back within the recommended creative count.
en.stop_condition: Do not scale while over the cap: a bigger budget only concentrates delivery on fewer creatives.

actions.action: 查被拒审 / 学习受限 / 余额与支付 / 竞价过低；被拒审的按 AD_STATUS 修正或申诉，不靠关停再开启触发重审；其余原因处理后复拉仍为 0 才重启
actions.acceptance: 已定位到四项中的具体一项；复拉仍为 0 才激活。
actions.stop_condition: 额度字段读回为 null 时不得对余量下结论，如实说明能力缺口。

en.trigger: At least one ad set configured ACTIVE, but today's spend is 0
en.action: Check disapprovals / learning limited / balance and payment / bids too low. A disapproval goes to AD_STATUS (fix or appeal), never an off/on toggle to trigger a new review; for the other causes, restart only if a re-pull still shows 0
en.acceptance: Traced to one of the four causes; reactivate only if a re-pull still shows 0.
en.stop_condition: If the spend-cap field reads back null, draw no conclusion about the remaining headroom; state the capability gap.

actions.action: 确认真断档还是暂停尾巴；先读账户状态：账户被停用或受限时停止，交人工走平台官方申诉，不在本账户或其他账户重建投放；账户正常且确认需要恢复时，按 build-paused -> verify -> activate 执行
actions.acceptance: 已区分真断档与暂停尾巴，且恢复过程有回读确认。
actions.stop_condition: 看到 PAUSED 先核对操作来源与暂停原因，未经确认不得当异常自动恢复。账户被停用或受限时不得重建、复制或转移投放。

en.trigger: No ad set returned, or none configured ACTIVE
en.action: Tell a real delivery gap from the tail of a deliberate pause. Read the account status first: if the account is disabled or restricted, stop and hand it to a person for the platform's own account review; never rebuild delivery in this or another account. Only when the account is in good standing, recover through build paused → verify → activate
en.acceptance: A real gap is told apart from a pause tail, and recovery is confirmed by readback.
en.stop_condition: On seeing PAUSED, check who paused it and why; never auto-resume it as an anomaly without confirmation. If the account is disabled or restricted, do not rebuild, copy or move delivery.

actions.action: 立即充值（历史上撞额度上限曾引发投放断崖）
actions.acceptance: 充值到账，复拉余额与当日消耗已恢复。
actions.stop_condition: 余额字段不等于剩余额度，不得用它反推额度上限。

en.action: Top up now (an exhausted balance or spend limit stops delivery abruptly)
en.acceptance: The funds have arrived; a re-pull shows the balance and today's spend recovering.
en.stop_condition: The balance field is not the remaining spend-cap headroom; never infer the cap from it.

actions.acceptance: 回读新预算已生效，覆盖 >= 2 个完整投放日，且该档独立算 CPA <= T。
actions.stop_condition: 撞额度上限或利用率顶满时先确认账户额度再加。扩量只加预算，不加 adset。

en.trigger: A proven ad set past the ladder that keeps its CPA ≤ T
en.action: Raise the original ad set's budget by 20%
en.window: After at least 2 full delivery days
en.acceptance: Readback shows the new budget in effect over ≥ 2 full delivery days, and the step's own CPA ≤ T.
en.stop_condition: At the spend limit or full utilization, confirm the account limit first. Scale by budget only, never by adding ad sets.

actions.action: 停止加量，回调上一档或暂停；盈利的原组继续保留
actions.acceptance: 回调或暂停已生效，且盈利的原组仍为 ACTIVE。
actions.stop_condition: 单日波动不足以回调，必须等数据成熟；不得因一天超标就砍掉盈利组。

en.trigger: CPA above T after a scale-up, on mature data
en.action: Stop scaling; step back one level or pause; keep the profitable original ad set running
en.acceptance: The step-back or pause is in effect, and the profitable original ad set is still ACTIVE.
en.stop_condition: One day's swing is not enough to step back; wait for mature data, and never cut a profitable ad set over one bad day.

actions.action: 保留原 MAX，只新开 1 个受控出价验证，初始预算约等于已验证可盈利预算
actions.acceptance: 原组未动，新组回读 bid_strategy / bid_amount / optimization_goal 与方案一致，预算已计入总测试额度。
actions.stop_condition: 出价低于已验证成本时风险是花不出去，不是省钱；样本不够不得下「受控出价压不住成本」的结论。

en.trigger: A proven MAX ad set where a controlled bid is worth testing
en.action: Keep the original MAX ad set; open one controlled-bid test with an initial budget close to the proven profitable budget
en.window: After at least 2 full delivery days
en.acceptance: The original ad set is untouched; the new ad set reads back bid_strategy / bid_amount / optimization_goal as planned, and its budget counts toward the total test budget.
en.stop_condition: A bid below the proven cost risks not spending, not saving money; without enough sample, do not conclude that a controlled bid cannot hold cost.

actions.action: 只识别、不提动作；由新结构取代，硬异常除外
actions.acceptance: 新结构计划已覆盖该 offer，旧结构无需任何动作。
actions.stop_condition: 不得以「优化」为名去动旧结构（不重建、不修补）。

en.trigger: An older structure running above target CPA that the ladder replaces
en.action: Identify only, propose nothing; the new structure replaces it, except for hard anomalies
en.acceptance: The new structure covers the offer; the old structure needs no action.
en.stop_condition: Do not touch the old structure in the name of optimization (no rebuild, no patching).

actions.action: 确认是我方主动关停；若是我方误删且它本来在出转化，按原批准方案以暂停状态重建、读回后再启用；被平台拒审或移除的对象不重建，按拒审分诊处理
actions.acceptance: 已确认是我方主动关停，且该 campaign 当日消耗归零。
actions.stop_condition: 先建后删，不得先删后查。

en.trigger: A campaign we turned off or deleted still shows spend
en.action: Confirm we turned it off on purpose; if we deleted it by mistake while it was still producing leads, recreate it from the approved plan, paused, and read it back before activating. Never recreate an object the platform disapproved or removed; that goes to disapproval triage
en.acceptance: Confirmed as a deliberate shutdown by us, and the campaign's spend for the day is zero.
en.stop_condition: Build before removing; never remove first and check later.
